Me hon tera tu hai mera

Sabse alag sabse judaa

Dil k dharakne ka sabab

Qibla e mun banda e rab

Sabe alag sabse juda

Moulaع teri shan ajab

Tu hai shah e karbobala

Teri bulandi pe kare naaz khuda

Mera Sultan Ya Hussain A.s

Tera karam sabse ajeeb

Tune likha Hurع ka naseeb

Hum hein wafadar tere

Hum bane Zawar tere

Tere liye khalq hue

Uthta rahega ye Alam

Rok sakega na koi

Chalta rahega silsila

Mera Sultan Ya Hussainع

Yaa Hussainع Yaa Hussainع Yaa Hussainع

Tu hai shahenshah hai zaman

Teri ghulami klye khalq hue dono jahan

Arsh talak jae sadaa

Gonjay zamee(n) pr jo ye aylan mera

Mera Sulatn Yaa Hussainع

Aese kisi ko na mile

Tune bhujaya jo dia

Chorh k tanha naa gae

Tere sahaba ka sharaf

Naaz kare Shah e Najafع

Jounع o habeebع or zohairع

Jab chale maqtal ki taraf

Koi nahe khof e qaza

Kar gae ye khete hue jaan fidaa

Haye wo dashte bala or musibat ki ghari

Ya Husain, Maula Husain ibn-e-Ali, ae wali ibn-e-wali, ae sakhi ibn-e-sakhi

Mera sultaan ya Husain

1

Sab se alag sab se judaa

Mera sultaan ya Husain

Mera sultaan ya Husain

3

Uthta rahega ye alam

Taaziya daaroṅ ke qadam qadam

Mera sultaan ya Husain
